title: Police hunt for 'dangerous' suspect
article: MONTREAL - Police are asking for help from the public in locating Patrick Bellemare, 44, a suspect in a conjugal violence case who allegedly repeatedly punched a woman in the face and then also hit her with a blunt object in the early morning of September 22.
He then threatened the victim with further violence if she called the police.
Bellemare has brown hair and brown eyes, stands 5'9" (1.77 m) and weighs 190 lbs (86 k).
He has many tattoos including a bird on his left index finger, a naked woman on his shoulder and a snake on his chest.
Those with information of his whereabouts are asked to call 911 or Info-Crime at 514-393-1133.
